subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

After my father passed away, I used to look at a __series of stars__, trying to find the unknown.
solution:
The correct answer is **constellation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Constellation: **a group of stars that forms a pattern and has a name. (तारामंडल, नक्षत्र)​

 
 
• **Example:** The ***constellation* **Ursa Major contains the stars of the Big Dipper. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words is **option 2**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Galaxy: **the system of stars that contains our sun and its planets, seen as a bright band in the night sky. (आकाशगंगा; तारा समूह)
 
• **Caravan: ** group of people and animals that travel together, for example across a desert. (यात्रियों और पशुओं का दल जो एक साथ मिलकर सफ़र करते हैं)
 
• **Horde: **a very large number of people. (लोगों का झुंड, भीड़)

37:T85b,

The correct answer is **A****mateur**.
